name: MarkupLoom – JSON-LD Manager
author: Saubhik M

sections.description:
MarkupLoom provides a focused interface for adding structured data to individual WordPress content items.

Multiple schemas can be assigned to the same Page, Post, or WooCommerce Product. Enabled individual schemas are combined into a JSON-LD @graph.

The plugin also provides a global schema manager for site-wide rules.

Features

  • Multiple schemas per Page, Post, and WooCommerce Product.
  • Checkbox-based Post Type selection for global schemas.
  • Individual schema controls inside the WordPress editor.
  • JSON-LD @graph output for multiple individual schemas.
  • Product schema support for WooCommerce.
  • Custom JSON-LD support.
  • Dynamic placeholders for common WordPress values.
  • Global schema rules for the entire site, homepage, singular content, or selected post types.
  • Schema type allow-list.
  • Nonce and capability checks.
  • Safe JSON-LD encoding to prevent script-tag breakout.

Supported Schema Types

Pages:

  • WebPage
  • AboutPage
  • ContactPage
  • FAQPage
  • LocalBusiness
  • BreadcrumbList
  • Organization
  • Custom

Posts:

  • Article
  • BlogPosting
  • NewsArticle
  • FAQPage
  • HowTo
  • BreadcrumbList
  • WebPage
  • Organization
  • Custom

Products:

  • Product
  • BreadcrumbList
  • FAQPage
  • WebPage
  • Organization
  • Custom

Custom JSON-LD

Custom JSON-LD must be valid JSON.

Supported placeholders:

  • {{title}}
  • {{url}}
  • {{description}}
  • {{image}}
  • {{author}}
  • {{datePublished}}
  • {{dateModified}}

Example:

{
“@context”: “https://schema.org”,
“@type”: “WebPage”,
“name”: {{title}},
“url”: {{url}},
“description”: {{description}}
}

Quoted full-value placeholders are also supported.

Multiple Schemas

A single content item may contain multiple schemas, such as:

  • Product
  • BreadcrumbList
  • FAQPage

Enabled individual schemas are emitted together in a JSON-LD @graph.

WooCommerce

When WooCommerce is active, Product schema can use:

  • Product name
  • Description
  • URL
  • SKU
  • Product image
  • Price
  • Currency
  • Stock availability
  • Brand
  • GTIN
  • MPN

Security

MarkupLoom validates custom JSON before storing it and re-encodes schema data with wp_json_encode() and JSON hexadecimal encoding flags before placing it inside a JSON-LD script element.

Administrator-only configuration is protected by WordPress capability and nonce checks.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 6.4 or later.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce is optional.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the markuploom-json-ld plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or upload the ZIP through Plugins → Add New Plugin.
  2. Activate MarkupLoom.
  3. Edit a Page, Post, or WooCommerce Product to configure individual schemas.
  4. Use MarkupLoom in the WordPress admin menu for global schema rules.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial MarkupLoom release.
  • Added global schema manager.
  • Added multiple individual schemas for Pages, Posts, and WooCommerce Products.
  • Added JSON-LD graph output.
  • Added WooCommerce Product schema support.
  • Added custom JSON-LD and placeholders.
  • Added secure JSON-LD output.
  • Replaced global schema Post Type multi-select with checkbox selection.
